learnings: Reuse one `aiohttp.ClientSession` per client – it owns the connection pool and must be closed in `__aexit__`.
A `Semaphore` caps requests in flight so concurrency stays polite to servers.
Async generators stream results as they finish; cancel outstanding tasks if the consumer stops early.
pitfalls: Tests must never depend on the internet – a local aiohttp `TestServer` makes the HTTP lesson real and deterministic.
